notes: Ordinary NSE cash equities, resident retail rates; excludes ETF-specific exemptions, BSE and MTF.
Turnover rates are fractions, monetary caps and DP are INR. Brokerage is min(cap, rate * notional) per executed order.
NSE exchange charge is INR 307/crore INCLUDING IPFT INR 0.01/crore; see https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FA73061.pdf . IPFT is disclosed, never added again.
GST is 18% of brokerage + exchange + SEBI. DP is INR 15.34 INCLUDING GST, once per scrip per sell day; standard tariff before account-holder discounts.
